rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a professional banker who conducts or runs banking business.

example.english: The banker explained the new financing plan at the meeting.
example.traditional: 銀行家喺會議上講解新嘅融資方案。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 gaa1 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 gong2 gaai2 san1 ge3 jung4 zi1 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this for the dealer who manages and deals a casino table game.

example.english: The banker at this table deals the cards very quickly.
example.jyutping: ni1 toi2 go3 ho4 gun1 paai3 paai4 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for the house or player who holds the bank in a gambling game rather than specifically the person dealing the cards.

example.english: The banker took all the money in this round.
